Commentary: The umpires make their way out to the middle. Raza has the ball in his hand at the moment. Is he going to open the bowling again or he is going to throw it to a pacer? No, he is setting the field and the keeper is up, so Raza will open the bowling. "Let's play" says the ump.
Vaibhav Sooryavanshi and Abhishek Sharma are at the crease. Vaibhav Sooryavanshi is on strike. Sikandar Raza will open the attack

Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, needs no sighters! Wants to get under this flighted delivery straightaway and wants to have a lofted drive, thick outside edge goes to the left of short third man and it escapes for a first-ball four
Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, now Vaibhav plays a nice punch-drive with the turn and picks out the fielder at cover-point

Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 2 wides, oh he's sprayed this down the leg-side. They steal a bye. Short fine leg has a shy at the stumps when the keeper wasn't ready. Tadiwanashe Marumani had to move to the right to stop the ball from Raza and he was rolling on the floor. He came in the firing line of the throw and literally had his hand up asking his mate not to throw as it could hurt him, then he manages to just escape the throw
Sikandar Raza to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, pushed to cover and Abhishek is away as well
Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, FOUR, brilliant lofted punch drive from Sikandar Raza, Vaibhav gets under it and lifts it over cover for a boundary
Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 5 wides, again Raza sprays down the leg-side and this time it's wide of short fine leg so it runs all the way to the fence
Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, no run, flatter delivery, Vaibhav keeps it out to cover-point
Sikandar Raza to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, flatter delivery, Vaibhav punches it to deep cover
17 off the over with 7 extras in it
Blessing Muzarabani, right-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Blessing Muzarabani to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, shouts of catch is as Vaibhav plays a cheeky upper cut, third man was a bit wide so he landed in front of him before he could reach
Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, no run, short of length delivery outside off stump, Abhishek defends off the back foot to point
Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, 1 run, short of length and angling away, steered off the back foot to third man
Blessing Muzarabani to Vaibhav Sooryavanshi, 1 run, unconventional dab off the back foot to this rising short of length delivery, plays it to the left of third man
Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, THATS OUT!! Caught!!

Blessing Muzarabani to Abhishek Sharma, out Caught by Tadiwanashe Marumani!! Edged and gone! Blessing Muzarabani has got Abhishek Sharma in all three games now and he's only got single digits in all those games. Fullish delivery angling away, Abhishek steps out while making room and tries to smash it over cover, his favoured shot in the PP. But he gets a healthy edge and the keeper takes an easy catch. Abhishek Sharma c Tadiwanashe Marumani b Blessing Muzarabani 2(4)
Ishan Kishan, left handed bat, comes to the crease
Blessing Muzarabani to Ishan Kishan, 1 run, to deep backward point
Newman Nyamhuri, left-arm fast medium, comes into the attack
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, FOUR, stays back and guides it
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, wide
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, wide, another one wide of off stump
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, wide, make it a hat-trick of attempts where Newman Nyamhuri is trying to hide the ball wide of off
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, no run, now Nyamhuri decides to come close the batter, so it's a length delivery just outside off stump. Pushed to cover-point
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, no run, he bowls a full toss now, Ishan mistimes
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, no run, it's the widish outswinger outside off stump, Ishan Kishan slashes hard and misses.
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, no run, lovely fullish outie close to off, drawing Ishan forward and forcing a defensive push to cover-point
Newman Nyamhuri to Ishan Kishan, no run, nice cover drive but Raza has packed the off-side field for Newman Nyamhuri so the drive finds extra-cover
